column1: # Bridge methods of 1.6.4 jars (see BridgeMethods): methods a mod overrides with a 1.6.4 signature that the 1.7.10 shim never calls.
# owner TAB oldName TAB oldDescriptor TAB newName TAB newDescriptor   (all in legacy form: 1.6.4 types left, 1.7.10 types right; relocated by the loader)
# A mod class below `owner` that declares oldName+oldDescriptor gets a 1.7.10-shaped method that calls it, converting ids and objects: an int where the new
# descriptor has a Block or Item (and back for the result) goes through the id facade, other differing reference types are cast; trailing parameters the
# old method lacks are dropped. Calls of oldName+oldDescriptor on shim types (also `super.` calls) are rewritten to the new method.
